Academic Profile

About

I am a business and management academic holding two earned doctorates — a PhD in Educational Management and a Doctor of Management — with nine years of teaching experience across undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in the UAE and the Philippines.

Currently I serve as Lecturer and Postgraduate Programs Coordinator at Walsh College UAE and Lecturer in Business & Management at the University for the Creative Arts (UCA) @ FEUC, delivering MBA units in leadership, business ethics, and research, and supervising Final Major Projects.

My research centres on sustainable human resource management — Green HRM and employee green behaviour — alongside work–family dynamics and consumer psychology, with Scopus-indexed and refereed outputs and advanced competence in PLS-SEM. I combine practitioner HR experience with curriculum leadership in outcome-based education and accreditation (PAASCU, CHED, ISO) to deliver research-informed, industry-aligned business education.
